content: {"like":["Enjoys high‑quality, family‑friendly entertainment with clean humor and slapstick comedy","Values strong visual presentation—great animation, HD video, realistic effects","Prefers stories with positive, hopeful endings and inspirational moments","Appreciates well‑acted, well‑directed films that blend action and humor","Seeks content that is engaging for all ages without foul language or serious themes"],"dislike":["Dislikes films that cut essential action or kill scenes, feeling unexciting","Avoids poorly written scripts and lackluster fear tactics that feel gross or unoriginal","Rejects misleading covers or short runtimes that diminish the experience","Finds alien propaganda or knee‑jerk horror reactions off‑balance and unfulfilling","Prefers not to watch content with limited seasons or minimal storytelling depth"]}
